sources.contract: Original pinned gomobile copies source to per-architecture temporary directories, writes a module, runs go mod tidy, then builds the archive.
getModuleVersions reads the effective native module graph, copies replacement directives including local native source, and writes the generated gobind module.

native_build_outputs: Pinned deps/.gitignore ignores tool outputs; dist/.gitignore ignores ios/*, verified with git check-ignore. No extra native source exclusions were added.
